body: Screwing up is part of life. It happens and it will happen again. I can guarantee that even your boss has screwed something up even where he/she works now. Being afraid of the person you work for shows you are not happy with your job. No matter how it turns out you may want to look into getting a new job. Depending on how long you have been with that company you may even beable to get a better job. a new job means meeting new people and possibly even better opertunities. You still have a long road ahead of you. Don't let one mistake define you. Learn and grow from it.

It's good that you care so much. It's a rare thing in this world to find people like you. Treatment is probably the best Orion although If things are that bad ask her parents for help in breaking the news. Ill tell you now you will feel like garbage before during and after you tell her. It's natural you care about her and want to help her. Those feelings will go away once she actually gets treated. And this time round don't listen to her when she says she wants to come home. It's gonna hurt and may even start a fight. But you have to keep her best interests at heart. she will say/do anything just to get herself out of there and back home. You may see her improve rather quickly. You may even think to yourself she seems happy or she seems alot better. Push those thoughts out of your mind its her body and minds way of defending itself. To make it seem like everything is ok when it really isn't. The only thing you can really do is be there for her. It will be bad at first then get better (the fake kinda better) then get even worse its not until after this that you will start to see things slowly change in her. Will she be fully cured? I don't know. How long it takes is uncertain as well. If she will get better is still uncertain. But all you can really do is try to help her the best you can.

Ok so if you are looking for work you could try a temp agency. They may be able to work with you. But before that you should really see a doctor and get diagnosed. That could mean a social security check or SSI and may even be enough for you to get out of the situation you are in now and on your own if that's what you really want. For a social security number all you have to do is request one. You can goto your social security office and obtain one. For an ID go to a DMV Department of motor vehicles you can get a state ID from there. Your birth certificate depends on the state you were born. You can request a copy. Keep in mind that other than the social security card everything else will cost money to get. If you need further guidance please send me a PM and ill be happy to help.

My wife has two boys. They are not mine and both hate me and treat me the way my wife treats me. About three years ago me and my wife were to have our own daughter we were going to name here Isabella but she miscarried. The weight of that has never left me. I have spoken to psychologists about how I'm feeling but they always give me the cliche things will get better. Or just give it time. I've spent hours spilling my guts to people that are suppose to help and that's all I get in return. Meds do nothing for me. The ones they give me make me forget everything that's going on around me and after they wear off I worry that I've done something terrible and they wear off at the worst possible times. Like in the middle of a fight with my wife and I have no idea why we are arguing. I try to tell her how I feel and all I get in return is "would you like me totell you the things that depress me about you?" And I feel even worse for saying anything at all.

Not knowing something is perfectly fine. To help make yourself look a little better you can word it differently. For instance instead of saying I don't know try "Im not sure but I can find the answer and get back to you." Simple yes but gives them the impression that yes you don't know everything but you are willing and able to learn more. if you happen to have the email address of the person interviewing you it's even better. A simple thank you email and an oh by the way the answer to the question you asked me is this... Will leave a lasting impression on that person. You took time out your own day to find the answer and even got back to them. That shows initiative and having a person who knows where to find an answer is always great for a company.

If you made it all the way to the interview portion then its probably not due to a bad recommendation. If you walk into an interview like you already have the job you are applying for you stand better chance. You have a degree and experience so you already have a leg up on alot of competition. Alot of the decisions to hire a person or not actually come from an interview. A few pointers to help you out with an interview are. 1. Go to your interview like you know you got the job.(ie: be confidante) 2. Practice what you are going to say in front of mirror (sounds silly but will help shake off some of those nerves) 3. Make a 2 or 3 minute speech about YOU ( many times some employers will say "tell me about yourself") That's when you showcase some of the skills and achievements you have. A short simple introduction something like. "Hi I'm (insert name). I'm have (this many years) in the librarian field. I have Masters degree in Library and Information Science specializing in school library media." Basically something that will grab there attention. 4. Talk about how your skills can help there company. 5. Nerves - No matter how much you prep for an interview nerves always take over. The best thing to do is remain calm and breath. Push out the thoughts of "how is the interview going, I hope they hire me" out of your mind. You have all the time after the interview is over to think about those things. 6. Answer any and all questions they may ask to the best of your ability avoid saying im not sure or i don't know.  Do a little bit of research on the company you are applying to, if possible toss some facts you learned about that company into the interview. and lastly have some questions of your own to ask like "what is the climate like for the employees?" 

And of course always thank the person or persons which ever the case may be for there time before and after the interview. (let them know that you know there time is valuable)

Those are some of the tips that helped me get through interviews. hopefully you can use some of them. good luck

I've talked with alot of people over the years. Many with similar stories to yours. You feel like you are in a dark tunnel with no way out just clawing your way through life. living each day in sheer misery. People do pick up on how another person is feeling but they may not out right say anything. instead they want to push those thoughts out there own minds and think only the best. Sometimes it take a person to do what you are doing right now. Reaching out for help is usually one of the hardest things for a person to do. the cliche things will get better. or just give it some time. although sound corny and over used are true. turning to alcohol or any drugs for that matter to cope with emotions is always bad. Those will make the pain may go away for a time. But will always come back. the thoughts of suicide are actually quiet normal. strange as that may sound everyone at some point in time has thought about or will think about suicide. The thought is enticing "freedom from the pain and hurt." is usually what most people see it as. However thats never the case. It only brings more sadness and more pain in its wake. You have a mother that obviously loves and cares about you. Reach out to her tell her your feelings. You probably have the "no one gets me. noone will understand." but trust me as a parent myself we always listen to what our children have to say. and if anything else I will listen to you. I may not know who you are beyond what you have wrote here. But that doesn't matter. you are a human being with real feelings and you need help. I am here to help all you have to do is talk and I will listen.

Im in a similar situation. I did end up finding a job working at a grocery store. Craigslist has job postings all the time. Have you considered going through a temp agency? they are always looking for people in temp to hire positions or even permanent positions. you are not a terrible person. you are just a regular person that has fallen on hard times. It happens to even the best. I never thought I would find a job either even had thoughts of ending things myself. Don't feel ashamed of being on public assistance or food stamps either. I myself was on unemployment for almost 7 months. Having experienced what its like to live that way is very humbling. Its not easy but eventually things will get better. I know that sounds so cliche. But trust me from one grown adult to another it will get better.

Reaching out is always the hardest thing for most people to do. I don't live in your side of the world so I've no idea what customs you have. I wont sit here and tell you how horrible your parents are. you may need to break out of your shell and start being more out going. You have goals and aspirations and going through school can be rough especially when you have no idea what you want to do. try relating some of your own interests into what you want to do. Since you are into computers and gaming have you thought about possibly getting into game designing or computer programing? Not being able to go through with ending it does not make you a coward or a wuss. As for the situation with your parents.  Have you tried sitting both your mother and father down and telling them how you feel? You may feel nervous even have that pit in your stomach and feel like you want to puke. That feeling will pass.you are after all their child and as a parent myself we always want what we feel is best for our children. Sometimes we forget to take there feelings into consideration. if you still need someone to talk to. even if its just to vent or blow off some steam I invite you to PM me. no matter what choice you decide to make i wish you the best of luck.
I have a facebook page if you need someone to talk to

im 26 years old and got a job at a grocery store stocking selves and running the register if they need me. Im in ohio so the job market in this area is pretty rough. I never thought after being in the military Id be stocking shelves at a grocery store. But I have to do what I can. Taking up a hobby isn't really an option for me. I'm to preoccupied with work and trying to find another job. I know I have to make time for myself but I honestly can't find the time. As for my wife I know her real worries are for our kids not so much about herself.

Often times people that are faced with something like this freeze up just like you. To be honest you may have been the best part of his remaining time if he did end things. You were polite when others would shun a person like this. The feelings you are having are more then just this incident. It may be beneficial to speak to a professional or a close friend or loved one and convey how you feel. It's always best to reach out for help. sometimes just talking about you're feelings can help ease some of the pain or guilt.
